# Hickory Grove Christian School — The Arts (Deep Research)

**Provenance**

- **Compiled by:** Claude Code deep research pass (`/implement add-hickory-grove-christian`).
- **Date compiled:** 2026-08-17
- **School:** Hickory Grove Christian School, Charlotte, NC (TK–12; ~800 students; founded
 1995 by Hickory Grove Baptist Church; accredited SACS / ACSI).
- **Method:** Scoped web fetch/search (hgchristian.org arts pages, Blumenthal Arts, general
 web). All figures/titles copied char-for-char. The **2025** Blumey nominee/finalist ledger
 was extracted from the official Blumenthal PDF via `pdftotext -layout`, so
 category→nominee→show mapping is exact. The **2026** Blumey names were read from the
 official Blumenthal nominees/finalists news page.

**Facilities note:** No named auditorium, theater, black box, band room, art studio, or
gallery is published on any HGCS arts page. **Facilities = NOT FOUND → omit** (do not ship a
Facilities card).

sections.text:
- **Early Education / Elementary (TK–5):** Visual arts instruction at every level. General
 music curriculum aligned to National Standards for Music Education: singing, rhythm
 instruments and Orff instruments, recorder introduced in **fourth grade**, composing
 rhythmic patterns and melodies, cross-disciplinary connections (science, math, language
 arts, technology). Visual-art foundation skills: shapes, colors, texture, value, 3D
 objects. (S1/S2/S3)
- **Middle School (6–8):** Band (sixth-grade beginners; seventh–eighth-grade intermediate
 levels), Choir (open to all MS students), Theatre (stage presence, speech, backstage
 elements), Musical Theatre (acting, singing, dance). Performance opportunities: Christmas
 Chapel, school-wide musicals, Winter/Spring Performing Arts Concerts, ACSI band festivals
 (previously earned superior ratings). Visual arts: original artwork, color mixing, artist
 studies (e.g., Picasso), mixed-media portraits. (S1/S2/S3)
- **High School (9–12):** Concert Band & Jazz Band, Choir, Musical Theatre, Theatre,
 Technical Theatre; Visual Arts (Art I–IV, AP Studio Art 2D, Art Appreciation);
 Yearbook / Student Media (*Exodus*). Semester-long advanced performing-arts courses
 emphasize performance, music analysis, and dance. (S1/S2/S3)

sections.text:
**Output:** Drama students mount **three productions per year** and compete in fall
competitions; a **large-scale spring musical every two years** (biennial) features students
across grade levels. (S1) Director names, venue, and full recent-season title list beyond the
Blumey-recognized shows are **NOT PUBLISHED** on the arts pages.

**Blumey ledger (Charlotte-region high-school musical theater awards, Blumenthal Arts):**

Confirmed against the official Blumenthal sources by searching "Hickory Grove" in each.

*2025 — production: **Seussical*** (from the official 2025 Blumey All Nominees & Finalists
PDF, S5):

| Year | Show | Category | Nominee / Role | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2025 | Seussical | Best Featured Performer | Amara Aghedo as Sour Kangaroo | Nominee |
| 2025 | Seussical | Finalists for Best Actor | Christian Young as Jojo | Finalist |
| 2025 | Seussical | Finalists for Best Actress | Fallon Burns as Mayzie | Finalist |
| 2025 | Seussical | Finalists for Best Supporting Actor | Michael McCray as Mr. Mayor | Finalist |
| 2025 | Seussical | Finalists for Best Supporting Actress | Mackenzie Moore as Mrs. Mayor | Finalist |
| 2025 | Seussical | Finalists for Best Featured Performer | Amara Aghedo as Sour Kangaroo | Finalist |

*2026 — production: **Disney's The Little Mermaid*** (from the official 2026 Blumey
nominees/finalists news page, S6):

| Year | Show | Category | Nominee / Role | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026 | Disney's The Little Mermaid | Best Supporting Actor | Christian Young as Scuttle | Nominee |
| 2026 | Disney's The Little Mermaid | Best Supporting Actress | Gabby Coleman as Flounder | Nominee |
| 2026 | Disney's The Little Mermaid | Best Featured Performer | Amara Aghedo as Aquata | Nominee |

**Notes for the app:**
- The brief's headline facts confirm: **2025** Amara Aghedo (*Seussical*) — verified as a
 Best Featured Performer **nominee**; **2026** Christian Young — verified, with *The Little
 Mermaid* recognized. Amara Aghedo recurs across both years.
- In the 2025 PDF the "Finalists for …" lists are per-production finalists distinct from the
 six overall nominees; Aghedo appears both as an overall **Best Featured Performer nominee**
 and in the **Best Featured Performer finalists** list. Both are transcribed verbatim.
- No Blumey **win** is published for HGCS in either year.

sections.text:
- **HS ensembles:** Concert Band, Jazz Band, Choir. (S1) — the arts hub explicitly lists
 Concert **and** Jazz band tracks.
- **MS ensembles:** Band (beginner Gr 6 / intermediate Gr 7–8), Choir. (S2)
- **Elementary:** general music (National Standards–aligned), Orff/rhythm instruments,
 recorder from grade 4. (S2)
- **Orchestra:** **NOT FOUND / not offered** — no orchestra or strings ensemble is published
 at any level. **A cappella:** NOT PUBLISHED.
- **Festivals / adjudication:** Band students participate in **adjudicated festivals
 annually**; MS band has earned **superior ratings at ACSI band festivals**. Choir performs
 at community events, **statewide festivals, and out-of-state tours**. (S1/S2)
- **Music honor society:** **Tri-M Music Honor Society** (S2).

- **HS course sequence:** Art I, Art II, Art III, Art IV, **AP Studio Art 2D** (i.e. AP 2D
 Design), Art Appreciation. (S3)
- **AP performance (published):** AP Studio Art students "consistently scoring 3 or 4 on the
 AP exam" (scores dipped during remote learning). (S3)
- **K–5 / MS progression:** K–5 foundation skills (shapes, colors, texture, value, 3D
 objects); MS original artwork, color mixing, artist studies (e.g., Picasso), mixed-media
 portraits. (S3)
- **Competitions/exhibits:** Visual-arts students "display work throughout the year and
 compete in public/private competitions." (S1) No named gallery/exhibit or **National Art
 Honor Society** is published (S3).
